key_test: two-sided one-sample t-test of per-participant proportion correct on triplet_type=='real' test trials (16 per participant) against 0.5; d = t/sqrt(n)
exclusions: none (pseudo-triplet trials discarded by design; no participants excluded)
agreement: Table and Python agree exactly on t, df, p and d; R not run (R.matlab missing).
notes: n_rows_raw = 15 files x 32 test trials. Per-participant proportions match the report's table of recall rates (e.g. 81, 63, 94, 81, 100 ...). Script defects noted by the survey stand: n <- nrow(p.cor) on a vector is NULL, so its d line would fail even with R.matlab; d = t/sqrt(15) is what the report uses. Exploratory exclusion of aware participants is not part of the key test.
